decision.explanation: Both answers are valid and refer to separate, distinct Wikimedia projects under which Malika Sonnet has been listed on a focus list. The first (NL Gendergap maintenance) appears in D1S3 and relates to her advocacy for gender equality. The second (WikiProject Badminton/tournament focus list) appears in D2S15 and pertains to her contributions to badminton. These are two distinct referents and should be preserved as complementary answers.
